notes.title: 2nd Anniversary Sale
notes.content:
It's Suzy Cube's 2nd Anniversary! 

Thank you so much to all the fans that have played over the past two years. We couldn't have done it without you!

Suzy Cube is on sale for a limited time for $0.99 starting June 19th to celebrate! Purchase Suzy Cube on all your favourite platforms!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/780500/Suzy_Cube] Steam [/url]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.noodlecake.suzycube] Google Play Store [/url]

[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/suzy-cube/id1293337633] App Store [/url]


We'll also be hosting a 2nd anniversary stream. Join Kay-Lynne from Noodlecake Studios and Louis-Nicolas from Northern Bytes Games for some fun gameplay and commentary! 

11:30 AM CST (Saskatchewan) on Friday, June 19th, 2020 on the Noodlecake YouTube channel!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/NoodlecakeGames/live] Noodlecake YouTube Channel [/url]


Happy Birthday, Suzy!

notes.title: An update to Suzy Cube is now available
notes.content:
Hey guys, just wanted to announce that v1.0.4 of [b]Suzy Cube[/b] is now live!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32931090/30e75d1b3731d3b88488794b583e916e096dc5e9.png[/img]

 In this release we fixed some lingering achievement issues, resolved a few minor bugs and added global Steam leaderboards! We're excited to see your best Suzy speedruns!

notes.title: Suzy Cube has launched!
notes.content:
Suzy Cube is finally here! After 3 long years of development we are super excited to bring her to Steam. This has been Louis labor of love for a long time and we couldn't be happier to be the ones to help him. Early reviews have been awesome and we are glad everyone is digging the 3D platforming charm.

We have been collecting a few bug reports about some of the menus acting a bit funny. If anything else pops up, please let us know in the comments. As well if you interested in a code for review purposes, please email press@noodlecake.com with your Curator Connect details or other info if you are not in that system. 

Cheers and happy platforming! ːsteamhappyː

~Team Noodlecake

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32931090/56e40ceeed090eac4889e39ad36e4c1205687e43.png[/img]

notes.title: Release Date and Launch Price!
notes.content:
Just wanted to let you all know that Suzy will be available on June 19th for $7.99. However we are doing a launch sale at 40% off for a limited time! 

~ Team Noodlecake

notes.title: Wish List!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We are super excited to announce that Suzy Cube is now open for wish listing and will be launching very soon. We couldn't be more excited about bringing this amazing 3d platformer to Steam as our first official release on the platform.

Please tell all your friends the game is coming and follow Suzy on the final leg of her 3 year journey! 

~ Team Noodlecake
